name: Bulgaria

pet.recycling_rate: SOURCE: plastic packaging recycled in Bulgaria: 39.5% in 2022 (Eurostat env_waspacr, rates for the 2025 target, table updated 10 November 2026); all plastics together, no separate figure for PET bottles; only one year reported
